patches.name: Controller velocity fix
patches.description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.

libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.

patches.name: Experimental Single Projection Fovea Quads
patches.description: 5002322-only permission-free experiment. Keeps one original projection and preserves Steam Link's native per-eye foveal images as eye-isolated far-plane quads.

patches.name: Experimental Single Projection Reconstruction
patches.description: 5002322-only permission-free experiment. Reconstructs Steam Link's opaque full-FOV underside and alpha-foveated inset into one stereo projection before submission.

patches.name: Experimental Three Projection Sampler Proxy
patches.description: 5002322-only permission-free discriminator. Preserves Steam Link's three projection layers while resolving their source images into controlled sampleCount-1 proxy swapchains.

patches.name: Experimental Two Projection Drop Base
patches.description: 5002322-only permission-free discriminator. Drops only the redundant first opaque full-FOV projection while forwarding Steam Link's original underside and alpha-foveated projections unchanged.

patches.name: OLED color calibration
patches.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

options.description: Selects the gamma and saturation pair used in the 1087-byte video shader.
Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
Safe control retains GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8. Experimental mode requests linear GL_RGB10_A2 and applies an explicit sRGB EOTF. Galaxy XR runtime support is unverified.

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so: AArch64 MOVZ/MOVK at PLT cave adds value×1e6 ns to X2 in QSVLDeviceHmd::GetPose. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
